title: Gandhi Pirantha Mann
desc: Balu, determined to honour his late parents' fight against caste discrimination, takes on the oppressive forces led by Rukmani's father, seeking justice and striving for social reform.

title: Aayusu Nooru
desc: Azhagamma, a village girl, has two men vying for her affection, Subramani, her lover and the village doctor. However, she is confused about who she wants to be with and faces a dilemma.

title: Palakkattu Madhavan
desc: Madhavan, frustrated by his wife Lakshmi's success, adopts Pattu Maami, an elderly woman, for financial gain. But as their bond grows, Madhavan faces unexpected life changes and emotional growth.

title: Oru Kai Osai
desc: A man loses his voice after his mother's shocking death. Later, he falls in love with a doctor, who comes to practise in his village and helps everyone.

title: Chinna Durai
desc: Chinnadurai, a village do-gooder, helps people in distress but earns the enmity of a fellow villager Ponnambalam. Later, Ponnambalam tries to poison Chinnadurai, but he survives.
